en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial Central European town in a river valley. In the foreground is a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a river with a rocky shore. On the left stands a factory complex with tall chimneys and the name "S. WOLLE" on the facade. Across the river are several multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings; one bears a sign "Max Weichhold". In the distance a church with a tall spire rises above the rooftops, with hills and scattered buildings in the background. The caption at the top left reads "Aue i. Erzgeb." indicating the location in the Ore Mountains.
